email_subject: Application - HubSpot Marketing Architect: Automations & Growth
email_body:
Dear Elixir Solutions team,

I'm writing to apply for the HubSpot Marketing Architect: Automations & Growth role. With a technical background in digital marketing and hands-on experience in marketing automation, I'm drawn to your blend of strategy and execution in building automated customer journeys.

In my current freelance and junior roles, I use HubSpot's content marketing principles (certified in 2026) and apply automation daily: I build WordPress sites with structured data, use Python and LLMs to automate repetitive tasks, and integrate tools via MCP. At Episto, I manage CMS content and SEO for client sites, tracking performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. My front-end development experience (AngularJS, JavaScript) helps me implement workflows and integrations effectively.

I'm eager to bring my skills to your growing HubSpot ecosystem and support customers across Europe. I'm fluent in English and native in Turkish, with basic Dutch.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Elixir Solutions team,

I'm excited to apply for the HubSpot Marketing Architect: Automations & Growth position at Elixir Solutions BV. Your focus on designing automated customer journeys and building large-scale personalized campaigns aligns perfectly with my technical marketing background and my passion for using automation to drive growth.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I work at the intersection of SEO, content, and web development. I hold a HubSpot Content Marketing certification (2026) and apply automation daily: I use Python and LLMs to streamline repetitive tasks, integrate tools via MCP, and build WordPress sites with structured data and accessible markup. At Episto, I manage CMS content for client websites, run technical SEO audits, and track performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. My earlier front-end development experience (AngularJS, JavaScript) gives me a solid foundation for implementing workflows and integrations within a HubSpot ecosystem.

What draws me to this role is the opportunity to combine strategy with hands-on execution. I enjoy mapping out customer journeys, setting up lead scoring, and ensuring that every automation serves a clear business goal. I'm comfortable working in multi-language environments—I'm fluent in English, native in Turkish, and have basic Dutch—and I'm eager to support your customers across Europe.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my skills in automation, content, and web development can contribute to your team's success. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• HubSpot Content Marketing certified (2026), with hands-on experience in marketing automation using Python and LLMs.

• Experienced in building automated workflows and integrations via MCP, and in using analytics tools (Google Analytics, Semrush, Ahrefs) to track performance.
• Fluent in English, native in Turkish, with basic Dutch—ready to support multi-language customers across Europe.
• Proven ability to design and optimize websites for lead generation and customer journeys, including structured data and accessible markup.
